mapper.sql: tenant_id, id, `type`, aggregate_id, payload, `status`, attempts, next_attempt_at_ms, lease_owner, lease_until_ms, last_error, created_at_ms, finished_at_ms
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_outbox_message (tenant_id, id, `type`, aggregate_id, payload, `status`, attempts, next_attempt_at_ms, lease_owner, lease_until_ms, last_error, created_at_ms, finished_at_ms) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{id}, #{type}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{nextAttemptAtMs}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseUntilMs}, #{lastError}, #{createdAtMs}, #{finishedAtMs})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM cw_outbox_message WHERE (`status` = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at_ms <= #{nowMs}) OR (`status` = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until_ms <= #{nowMs}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at_ms, created_at_ms LIMIT #{limit}
